derivation: middle voice from G4253 (πρό) and G2097 (εὐαγγελίζω);
def: to announce glad news in advance

occurrences.text: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In thee shall all nations be blessed.
